name: @pipeworx/mcp-domains

tools.name: domain_lookup
tools.description: Get full registration details for a domain. Returns registrar, registrant, registration/expiration dates, nameservers, DNSSEC status, and domain status flags. Works for any TLD.

tools.name: domain_status
tools.description: Quick check if a domain is registered or available. Returns registration status and expiration date if registered.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check whether a name is available to register across MULTIPLE TLDs at once — the domain-hunting tool. Pass a base name ("acme") and get .com/.io/.ai/.co/.net/.org/.app/.dev checked in one call (or pass your own tlds list). For each: available true/false (+ expiration if taken). Use for "is X available", "find an open domain for my project", "which TLDs is X free on". Single-domain detail is domain_status; this is the bulk/brainstorm version.

name.description: Base name to check, e.g. "acme" (a full "acme.com" is also accepted — the label before the first dot is used).

tlds.description: TLDs to check (without the dot), e.g. ["com","io","ai"]. Default: com, io, ai, co, net, org, app, dev. Max 15.

tools.name: find_available_domains
tools.description: Search for AVAILABLE domain names to register from a keyword — the domain name search / brainstorming tool. Pass a keyword ("acme") and get back which domains are actually free to register: the exact name across .com/.io/.ai/.co/.app/.dev, plus creative variations (getacme.com, acmehq.com, tryacme.io, acmeapp.com, …). Use for "find me an available domain for X", "domain name ideas for my startup", "is there an open domain for X", "suggest domain names". Returns available domains ranked (exact match + .com first). Availability is a live registry (RDAP) signal, keyless. For a single specific domain use domain_status; to check one name across TLDs without variations use check_availability.

keyword.description: Base keyword or brand name to build domain ideas from, e.g. "acme".

tlds.description: TLDs to consider (without the dot), e.g. ["com","io","ai"]. Default: com, io, ai, co, app, dev. Max 10.

include_variations.description: Also try prefix/suffix variations (get-, try-, -app, -hq, …). Default true. Set false for exact-keyword-only across TLDs.

tools.name: certificate_search
tools.description: Find the SSL/TLS certificates issued for a domain from public Certificate Transparency logs (Cert Spotter). PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "what certificates does X have", "find subdomains of X", "when does X's TLS cert expire", "which CA issued X's cert". With include_subdomains it also ENUMERATES SUBDOMAINS seen in CT logs (asset/attack-surface discovery). Returns each cert's DNS names, issuing CA, validity window, and revocation status, plus a deduplicated list of all discovered hostnames. Keyless.

domain.description: Domain to search certificates for, e.g. "example.com".

include_subdomains.description: Also include certs covering subdomains (default true) — this is what enables subdomain discovery.

limit.description: Max certificates to list (1-100, default 30). The discovered-hostnames list is always complete.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-domains forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the domains pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
